headline: 电影剧集双线热：仙逆剧场版领跑，乌鸦学园首播
summary: 电影端，《仙逆剧场版：弑仙之战》领跑本周热作，待映片单还有《沙丘3》《复仇者联盟5》；剧集端，《乌鸦学园》《魔女嘉莉》本周首播，《侠探杰克》《绿灯军团》等热播剧维持热度。

industryHighlights.text: 电影热作：《仙逆剧场版：弑仙之战》领跑，《挖掘者》《不存在的罪人》《只要活下去》《牢笼鬼魂》在列。
industryHighlights.en: Movie heat: Xian Ni Film: Battle of Immortals leads, joined by Digger, The Nonexistent Sinner, Just Live, and Ghost in the Cage.

industryHighlights.text: 新剧首播：《乌鸦学园》《魔女嘉莉》《Mayday》《库比蒂诺》《暗潮之下》本周上线。
industryHighlights.en: New premieres: Crow Academy, Carrie, Mayday, Cupertino, and Under the Dark Tide launch this week.

industryHighlights.text: 热播续力：《侠探杰克》《绿灯军团》《母狮》《无职转生》《末日地堡》持续吸引观众。
industryHighlights.en: Returning hits: Reacher, Lanterns, Lioness, Mushoku Tensei, and Silo continue to draw viewers.

industryHighlights.text: 待映前瞻：《猫鼬》《复仇者联盟5》《街头霸王》《沙丘3》《泥面人》蓄势待发。
industryHighlights.en: Upcoming watchlist: Mongoose, Avengers 5, Street Fighter, Dune 3, and Clayface are gearing up.

headlineEn: Film & TV Buzz: Xian Ni Leads, Crow Academy Premieres
summaryEn: On the film side, Xian Ni Film: Battle of Immortals leads this week's hot titles, with Dune 3 and Avengers 5 on the upcoming slate; on TV, Crow Academy and Carrie premiere this week, while Reacher and Lanterns keep up momentum.
